clues.text: In Jerusalem, this pool lay near the Sheep Gate.
This pool in Jerusalem was surrounded by five covered colonnades.
A great number of sick, blind, lame and paralyzed people lay on the walkways around this Jerusalem pool.
When Jesus came to this place in Jerusalem, a man there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
Jesus saw a man lying here a long time and asked him, "Do you want to get well?"
A man lying here told Jesus that whenever the water was stirred, someone else went in before him.
At this place a man was healed on the Sabbath, then picked up his mat and began to walk.
